title: Deep learning on pre-therapy cardiac MRI predicts cancer therapy cardiac dysfunction
summary: Deep CNNs on pre-treatment cardiac MRI cine images predicted subsequent cardiac dysfunction in 229 women with HER2+ breast cancer (176 Toronto derivation, 53 Calgary external). AUC was 0.85 internally and 0.80 (95% CI 0.66-0.92) externally, versus 0.59-0.66 for clinical, CMR and echocardiographic models. The external cohort had 14 events, so confidence intervals are wide.
ai_technology: Deep convolutional neural networks on cardiac MRI short-axis cine images
organization: University Health Network; University of Toronto; Toronto General Hospital

evidence.tested: External validation in a Calgary cohort drawn from a prospective study.
evidence.unknown: Small external cohort; no prospective deployment. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep CNN predicted future cardiac dysfunction from pre-therapy cine MRI.
